verdict.rationale: Pigment has its own agents (Modeler, Analyst), so an MCP-client story is a fair question for it. However, the MCP evidence shows Pigment acting as an MCP server for external assistants like Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT. That is the server role, not the ability to plug MCP servers in. Its 'Agent Connectors' reach a fixed set of systems (Notion, Google Drive, Slack) and are never described as connecting arbitrary MCP servers. That makes them an adjacent feature that earns no credit here.
